transcript.text: I need to share my permit review findings. This morning I received a clarification from the environmental office regarding the permit requirements for this solvent recovery trial. I have not yet filed this clarification with the trial paperwork, so I want everyone here to be aware of these requirements before we proceed with the authorization decision.
